_about: Placeholder physics for the snack shelf's packages (snack_shelf/placements.json): estimates, not measured.
A package's mass = density x the volume of its bounding box (placements.json's size_m), so a bigger package of a
kind weighs more. 'density' is in kg per litre of that box: the contents and the packaging, divided by the box.
'friction' is MuJoCo's sliding friction coefficient (the larger of two touching surfaces' values counts).
'shape' is the collision shape: 'box' (placements.json's box; a bag's untilted box) or 'cylinder' (upright, its
diameter the smaller of the box's width and depth). Bags in the front row are deformable (a flex) when the
parameter 'deformable_bags' is on; the rest are boxes.
'products' overrides a kind's values for one product (its id in placements.json), e.g.
'fixtures': the friction of the shelf's parts (shelf.glb's fx_* nodes).

can._note: Pringles, crisps tubes: 165 g in a 7.5 x 23.5 cm can

tub._note: gwoon nut tubs: ~225 g (choco melange per spar.nl) + ~25 g tub

bag._note: chips and nut bags: 150-300 g of contents and air in plastic film

_clearance: each package's collision shape is this much smaller than its box (half on each side), so neighbours don't start touching
_pringles: Pringles: 165 g (large can) and 70 g (small), per spar.nl; plus ~40 g / ~30 g of can
